We are committed to empowering businesses through secure, innovative, and legally compliant digital solutions through our products including ViTEK (Digital Signature), ViMET (e-Meterai), and ViCAP (Digital Seal) . At Vinotek , you'll have the opportunity to work alongside passionate professionals, contribute to meaningful digital transformation initiatives, and grow your career in a dynamic environment that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning . We're looking for a Facility Engineer who is ready to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our IT infrastructure, data center operations, and network systems while supporting the delivery of trusted digital services. What You'll Do:  • Manage and maintain PSrE infrastructure, including servers, networks, and operating systems  • Oversee Data Center operations, network infrastructure, backup and recovery processes, physical access monitoring, system monitoring, and first-level technical support  • Collaborate with Data Center providers on maintenance, network configuration, equipment installation, relocation, and facility enhancement projects  • Be available for on-site support at the Data Center whenever required  • Maintain and safeguard the security of the company's information assets  • Perform other duties and responsibilities assigned by management or the company What We're Looking For:  • SMK/D3/S1 in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field  • Solid understanding of Server Hardware, Network Infrastructure, and Endpoint Devices  • Advanced Linux Server Administration and Virtualization expertise  • Strong knowledge of Network Administration and Security, including Firewall and Antivirus Solutions  • Strong integrity, responsibility, and reliability, with a clean professional record 🚀 Ready to Grow with Us? If you're driven by technology, infrastructure reliability, and information security, and want to play a key role in supporting trusted digital certification services, we'd love to hear from you. 📩 Send your latest CV Ensuring system reliability. Safeguarding digital trust. Powering secure digital transformation.

review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: MANTECH seeks a motivated, customer-oriented Systems Administrator to join our team in Chantilly, VA . This is an onsite position. The administrator will support the installation, operation, and maintenance of all current and future Information Systems. This position is a part of a centralized team of systems administrators. Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To Maintain and troubleshoot customer Windows workstations both on-site and remotely while providing day-to-day administrative support, including user access management, software installations, and file restores. Resolve incoming service tickets using diagnostic techniques, walking customers through step-by-step problem-solving processes to ensure high-quality, timely resolutions. Track, route, and escalate complex issues to appropriate support teams, maintaining end-to-end oversight to guarantee complete incident resolution and customer satisfaction. Log all service requests, system incidents, and maintenance tasks accurately in defined tracking software to maintain compliance with standard operating procedures. Author, review, and update standard operating procedures, technical manuals, and operational documentation using Microsoft Office applications. Proactively learn fundamental operations of new software and hardware equipment to adapt to evolving technical environments and customer needs. Deliver exceptional customer service through clear written and oral communication, maintaining a professional demeanor while working independently or collaboratively with team members. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with 1+ years of experience in Information Technology Experience with Microsoft Windows 2008/2012/2016 Servers, Microsoft Windows 10, Microsoft Office 2007/2010/2016 Working knowledge of vSphere, Horizon View, data backups, and antivirus software Basic networking experience, including TCPIP Experience with deploying workstation images or zero clients Experience using a Service Desk ticketing system, such as Remedy or ServiceNow DoD 8570 IAT Level II Certification required, e.g., Security+ CE Preferred Qualifications ITIL Foundations certification highly desired Willingness to work after normal duty hours (nights and weekends) as needed Previous customer service experience strongly desired Security Clearance Requirements Must have a current or active TS/SCI clearance and be willing and able to obtain a CI polygraph Physical Requirements The person in this position must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. Occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, or to communicate with co-workers, management, and customers, via email, phone, and or virtual communication, which may involve delivering presentations.
